tools.name: step_import
tools.description: Import STEP/IGES: Import a STEP or IGES file into the current scene. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

up_axis.description: Which axis pointed up in the CAD application this model came from. Usually Y for most CAD software. Try Z if your model appears lying on it's side after import (items depend on the scene)

rotation_deg.description: Degrees to rotate around the vertical axis after up-axis correction (items depend on the scene)

placement.description: Where to place imported objects in the scene

scale.description: Uniform scale multiplier applied to the imported geometry. Leave at 1.0 for correctly-exported files. Use 1000 if the model imports as millimetre-sized when it should be metres, or 0.001 for the reverse.

origin_offset.description: Adjust how the imported assembly is offset relative to the chosen placement location. This does not change object origins.

merge_objects.description: Join all imported bodies into a single mesh object

use_assembly_collections.description: Organise imported parts into nested Blender collections matching the STEP assembly hierarchy. Ignored when Merge Bodies is enabled.

tools.name: step_cleanup_selected
tools.description: Clean Up Topology: Run topology cleanup on all selected mesh objects. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
